managed.tagline: Serverless query offload — your database mints self-expiring capsules, our pool answers them. Buy concurrency for your local Postgres.

value_props.title: Per-request isolation
value_props.detail: Every offloaded query gets its own worker; a dashboard refresh storm never touches your database.

value_props.title: Zero standing creds
value_props.detail: Your brain presigns its own bucket URLs; the pool holds nothing and expires in minutes.

value_props.title: Scale-to-zero
value_props.detail: Idle costs nothing; bursts spin up capacity on demand.

highlights: A relief valve for Postgres under bursty analytical load
Unusual for a mixed on-prem database — buy concurrency without moving your data
privacy: We never store your inputs or outputs — metering records counts, timings, and token totals only
Never used for training — your traffic trains nothing
No standing credentials — your database presigns its own storage URLs; capsules expire in minutes
